name: hud_ui_layout_node_read_int3
description: HudUiLayoutNode::ReadInt3 reads up to three integers from a ZRDR array node into optional output pointers.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD layout/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x413ad0 validates returning 0 for non-array nodes, reading array payload integers into non-null out0/out1/out2 pointers, preserving null outputs, and returning 1 on success.
